title: Add Worker routing, CORS, and API integration tests
acceptance_criteria: The Worker routes all defined endpoints, returns consistent JSON errors, handles OPTIONS with 204, and allows only the configured production origin plus an explicitly configured development origin.
CORS allows only GET/PUT/POST/DELETE/OPTIONS and Authorization/Content-Type, includes Vary: Origin when needed, and never uses wildcard credentials.
Integration tests cover pairing, authenticated subscription and schedule uploads, status, revoke, invalid origins, preflight, invalid JSON, 401, 403, and no secret leakage in responses.
The Worker test suite passes with deterministic D1 and Web Crypto test doubles or a supported local D1 harness.
completion_summary: Implemented Worker routing, strict exact-origin CORS, safe HTTPS API errors, deterministic integration doubles, and endpoint coverage without Cron or push delivery.
